resources.string: Decides which public holidays and school vacations the calendar shows
Public holidays and school vacations are shown on the calendar. The spring break is set per district and is not shown.
Public holidays and school vacations are shown on the calendar, as the ministry publishes them. The spring holidays are set per region and are not shown.
Public holidays and the school vacations common to all of Austria are shown on the calendar. Semester and summer holidays are set per state and are not shown.
Public holidays for %1$s are not in the app yet, so none are shown.
Nationwide public holidays are shown on the calendar. School vacations for %1$s are not in the app.
Public holidays in %1$s are not days off while martial law is in force, so none are shown.
Adds that state\'s own public holidays and school vacations
Nationwide public holidays are shown on the calendar. School vacations are set per state: choose one to add its school vacations and its own public holidays.
Nationwide public holidays, and the public holidays and school vacations of %1$s, are shown on the calendar.
